# Stone Wing

Website: https://spindleandstone.com/

Stone Wing is a multi-model AI desktop workspace for Mac and Windows. It connects supported AI providers, files, MCP-compatible tools and authorized computers through Bridge, with governance and approval boundaries around consequential actions.

Key concepts:
- Mac + Windows available
- Multiple supported AI providers
- Manual and task-aware model routing
- Files and project context
- MCP-compatible tools
- Bridge for authorized cross-computer workflows
- Governance: VERIFY → AUTHORIZE → APPROVE → PROVE
- Supported provider free-tier access where available

Commercial offer:
- 7-day free trial; payment method required; then $9.99 CAD/month unless cancelled before the trial ends
- $99 CAD one-time Stone Wing license
- Third-party provider/API fees, limits and terms are separate from Stone Wing

Official support: https://spindleandstone.com/support.html
Official source: https://spindleandstone.com/
